prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Glimblehop environment art direction, a landscape 16:9 concept render, first review, not a gameplay screenshot or production asset.
Input images: Image 1 is the current Unity level-six diorama composition and intended route geometry, reference only; Image 2 is the approved cast, strict character identity reference; Image 3 is the chapter map, style/material reference only.
Primary request: upgrade the environment to the same lovingly crafted, warm storybook 3D quality as the existing characters and illustrated chapter map. Keep it a readable, elevated three-quarter view of ONE compact forest clearing on natural land beside a winding shallow turquoise stream. Eight separate warm limestone game slabs form ONE unbranched gently curving diagonal route from lower left to upper right, with a wooden footbridge crossing a narrow stream near the route end and an exit land patch beyond the final slab. Preserve the eight distinct game supports, do not add stepping stones that could be mistaken for extra playable slabs. A compact exit marker is one timber post with a short rust-red cloth pennant and a small amber lantern, no huge fantasy gate. The land is continuous and naturally joins the bank; avoid a floating toy island or exposed repeating low-poly perimeter cubes.
Composition: landscape game-camera concept, all eight slabs visible and their top surfaces readable. At the start, Tish is small but immediately readable with his established lime green skin, short chestnut spiky hair, big ears, red scarf, brown vest/shorts/boots and satchel, plus Luma and Bum grouped beside him, matching the approved cast exactly; no clothing redesign, no new companion. Calm ochre earth behind their silhouettes, avoid sharp foliage behind faces. Broad warm stone tops, varied hand-cut rounded edges, grounded thickness and contact shadows, restrained moss only at slab corners. Upper/right route end has the exit marker. Keep the lower 22 percent relatively calm and free of game slabs for the existing wooden HUD, but DO NOT draw any HUD, frames, buttons, labels, letters, numbers or logo in this image. Leave a quiet upper strip for existing title HUD.
Style: polished stylized 3D game environment concept with large soft sculpted tree masses, subtle tactile bark and limestone, grouped fern silhouettes, cream daisies in sparse clumps; not photorealistic, not faceted low-poly, not miniature plastic. Natural bank with larger embedded rounded rocks, softened dirt-to-grass transitions. Three asymmetric tree silhouettes frame the edges, backdrop recedes softly but the gameplay route stays sharp. Warm soft afternoon sun from upper left, gentle cool fill, soft contact shadows; no aggressive bloom, no excessive god rays or confetti.
Palette: cream limestone, ochre soil, moss and forest green, cool blue-green water, tiny amber lantern accent and rust-red cloth. The route and characters carry the highest useful contrast; background foliage is quieter.
Constraints: no new mechanics, no branching route, no extra UI, no equipment changes, no outfit variants, no fake game text, no screenshots pasted into decorative boards. The deliverable is one clean environment concept image.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Glimblehop FIRST LEVEL close game-camera concept, landscape 16:9, environment art proposal only.
Input images: Image 1 is the new approved direction for materials and lighting, use its warm limestone, soft sculpted trees, calm path, natural river bank and timber/cloth lantern exit marker. Image 2 is the existing Unity first-level framing, reference for context, not target to copy. Image 3 is the approved cast, use Tish ONLY and preserve his identity.
Primary request: close framing of Tish at the halfway start of the first level. There must be EXACTLY FOUR playable limestone slabs visible in the entire image: the first directly under Tish, then three empty slabs ahead. Arrange the four slabs clearly separated and countable in a single gentle diagonal progression from center-left foreground toward center-right background. No fifth slab, no other flat stepping stones, no hidden slabs behind Tish. After the fourth slab the route meets ordinary compact dirt ground, with one timber exit post, short rust-red cloth pennant and modest warm amber lantern; the exit is a land patch, NOT a fifth limestone slab. The area behind Tish is unbroken forest soil and grass, with no previous slabs and no holes.
Character: Tish from cast image: small green goblin boy, short dark chestnut spiky hair, huge beautiful ears, large amber eyes, short red scarf, patched brown leather vest and shorts, chunky brown boots, one brown satchel at the hip. His anatomical right ear alone has the already approved small bite notch, other ear whole. Keep original cute proportions and outfit, no staff, no extra bag, no costume change, no new hero. Tish stands normally with BOTH feet in contact with the first slab, clear contact shadow. Place him in a comfortable relaxed pose looking slightly toward the rustling bush at the LEFT edge, keeping both ears, hands and the red scarf unobstructed. That bush suggests Scratchy calling, but DO NOT show Scratchy or extra faces. A small rolled green bedroll and a few gathered sticks on ordinary soil behind Tish may suggest he was doing something; restrained, no camp clutter.
Composition: Tish is noticeably larger than in the general scene, approximately 15% closer camera scale than a full-route framing. All FOUR slabs and the exit pennant must fit simultaneously in the middle 65% of the image, well clear of the top 12% and bottom 24% reserved for current wooden HUD. Leave enough vertical space above his ears for a jump apex. Portrait character face is not needed. Keep the main route top surfaces broad, calm, warm ivory; modest chips and moss at corners only. Restrained local gold edge light on next destination, no glowing ring. A narrow shallow turquoise stream crosses near the route end, with bank edge and one short wooden bridge related to the final slab, but do not obscure any slab. If bridge makes the count ambiguous, omit bridge in this closer shot and let the stream run along the right edge.
Art direction: high quality cozy stylized 3D forest, tactility matching the cast; rounded heavy cream limestone grounded into ochre earth, varied grouped moss-green trees and fern silhouettes at sides, calm ground behind hero, soft distant trees. Warm sun upper left, gentle cool fill, soft contact shadows, tiny amber accent at exit. Avoid excessive flowers and noisy grass in the playable path. Natural continuous riverbank; no floating platform cutaway, no repeated cubes.
Constraints: ONE character only, EXACTLY FOUR slabs total plus a dirt exit patch. Do not draw HUD, buttons, text, numbers, arrows, logos, grids, labels, design-sheet frames, watermarks or any extra route. Clean full-bleed concept image.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: Glimblehop CHAPTER MAP concept, landscape 16:9. One refined, readable game screen, first art review.
Input images: Image 1 is the current chapter map screenshot. Preserve its warm dimensional illustrated woodland, wooden UI and single sequential six-node structure, while reducing noise and improving hierarchy. Image 2 is the existing 2D Tish sprite, STRICT identity and 2D cutout treatment reference; this exact sprite remains in the game and is NOT being redesigned. Image 3 is the new environment direction; use its cream limestone, ochre ground, grouped moss green foliage, cool turquoise water, soft warm light and grounded materials so the chapter map and gameplay feel like the same world.
Primary request: improve the chapter map, do not replace its dimensional wooden style with flat interface. EXACTLY SIX numbered stone level nodes, numbers "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", each appearing exactly once. Retain a single unbranched path linking nodes in that exact order, no alternative trail. Six nodes are the ONLY large flat interactable-looking stones. Natural decorative rocks should be rounded irregular boulders.
Landscape composition: keep river and waterfall along LEFT third; footbridge on the one path between node 1 and node 2; monumental soft tree shapes at left edge and right background; a warm open clearing at center. Positions in normalized frame coordinates approx node1(0.145,0.65), node2(0.32,0.47), node3(0.465,0.565), node4(0.66,0.465), node5(0.565,0.265), node6(0.785,0.27). Slight shifts allowed to give each node breathing room. The path connects 1->2->3->4->5->6, without false forks. Space between adjacent nodes remains calm earth/low grass. Limestone tops offer real foot support and broad front faces carry large dark brown numerals.
State design: nodes1,2,3 passed: small matching wooden and green round checkmark badge at upper right, NEVER covering the digit. Node4 current and available: subtle warm edge highlight, clear upper platform. Nodes5,6 locked: small muted warm-grey round wooden/metal lock badge at upper right, not hiding numbers; no gloomy black slab. Use shape and value, not color alone. No blinking rings around nodes.
Tish: place the existing 2D sprite visually centered ABOVE node4, both boot soles planted on the upper stone surface with small soft contact shadow. Preserve reference sprite proportions, scarf, outfit, friendly face, ears and visible illustrated cutout style; do not substitute a new 3D render or redesign the character. Hero does not cover the numeral or status badge. All six nodes remain easy to count.
UI: upper left a compact round wooden back button with cream left-arrow icon. At top center a shorter warm carved wooden chapter plaque, maximum ~40% of screen width and ~13% high; dimensional round bark frame, a small cluster of green leaves that preserves natural proportions, cream readable text exactly "ГЛАВА 1" and on second line "ЛЕСНАЯ ТРОПА". Plaque must not dominate the map or cover nodes. At bottom left compact wooden progress plaque with exact text "ПРОГРЕСС" and "3 / 6". At bottom right a GREEN carved wooden primary button, natural round ends with proportionate leaves separate from stretchable center, text exactly "ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ" and one small cream right arrow. Keep clean 5% safe outer margins. No other text or logo.
Style/materials: tactile, beautifully sculpted illustrated 3D storybook environment, NOT flat, not high-frequency photorealistic foliage. Warm limestone and natural moss only around stone edges; bold tree and fern silhouettes, restrained grouped cream daisies, quiet noninteractive foreground. River visually cohesive with continuous banks, small foam only at waterfalls and rocks. Sun upper-left warm with soft cool fill; route sharp, only distant forest softened. Scene detail must be lower immediately behind numerals, icon badges and hero. Existing coherent timber-and-leaf UI, not modern mobile pill cards.
Constraints: exactly six nodes and exactly one Tish sprite; no extra platforms, reward icons, coins, hearts, shop, energy, banners, new branches, new rules or extra characters. The deliverable is one clean full-screen art mockup, not a collage and not a photograph of a device.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: Glimblehop CHAPTER MAP PORTRAIT adaptation, a tall 9:16 screen concept, approximately 1080x1920. One image, no phone hardware, no collage.
Input images: Image 1 is the newly refined landscape chapter map, strict environment, UI material and node-state style reference. Image 2 is the existing 2D Tish sprite, preserve this exact original illustrated cutout identity and clothing. Image 3 is gameplay environment art direction; keep the same world.
Primary request: a genuinely recomposed VERTICAL chapter map, never a cropped or squeezed landscape. Six large cream limestone level stones fit in a vertical serpentine woodland journey. EXACTLY SIX nodes numbered "1","2","3","4","5","6", each once, connected by ONE unbranched warm ochre path in numeric order, traveling from bottom toward top. Arrange approximate normalized centers: 1(0.27,0.78), 2(0.66,0.67), 3(0.30,0.56), 4(0.67,0.45), 5(0.32,0.32), 6(0.66,0.22). Maintain generous spaces so route, numbers, badges and hero are unambiguous. Current node4 is on the right near upper middle, with the existing 2D Tish sprite boots firmly on the top surface, contact shadow, entire friendly silhouette visible; do not redesign sprite or change outfit. All six nodes and the whole primary action must be visible at once, no need to scroll in this concept. Natural foliage can crop at screen sides; interactive stones cannot.
States: nodes1,2,3 each have a small green wooden round check badge at upper right, no numeral covered; node4 available has gentle warm edge highlight, no neon halo; nodes5,6 have small muted warm-grey lock badges at upper right. No extra coins, hearts, diamonds or rewards. No extra flat platform-like boulders.
Environment: warm three-dimensional illustrated storybook woodland with soft sculpted broad tree masses at edges, distinct trunk at top right, the waterfall in upper left receding distance; a narrow turquoise stream winds down the LEFT side and crosses behind the single little wooden bridge specifically on the path between nodes1 and2. No alternative trails or extra bridges. Keep route clear with low foliage and calm ochre ground; restrained moss/cream daisies at stone corners. Cream stone tops broad and clean, readable dark numerals, grounded stone thickness. This is the same tactile world as landscape, but the geography is recomposed to the vertical screen.
UI: generous device safe margins (around5% width and3% height), top compact carved wooden chapter plaque with proportional leaves separate from central wood, cream text exactly "ГЛАВА 1" then "ЛЕСНАЯ ТРОПА"; plaque uses about76% width, remaining space for one small round wooden back arrow at upper-left. The header ends by normalized y.14, never covers node6. At the BOTTOM a compact wooden progress plaque carrying exact "3 / 6" centered above or immediately left of a wide GREEN carved wooden continue button with exact text "ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ" and one cream right arrow, no tiny extra text. Primary button about82% screen width and7% screen height, at y.91. UI text legible when whole mockup is shrunk to360x640. Large stone fronts with large numerals; touch targets will be at least44 logical units in implementation. Carved round ends and leaves keep their natural proportions, no stretching. No modern flat pills or floating white cards.
Lighting and palette: soft warm sun from upper left, gentle cool forest fill, honey timber/cream stone/ochre soil/moss green/turquoise water, restrained amber highlights. Quieter near stones and behind hero; background detail softened only far away. No black corners, no heavy vignette, no exaggerated sunbeams or bloom.
Constraints: six nodes only, one original 2D Tish only, one sequential route, no other characters, no 3D Tish substitute, no hero face changes, no ornate banners covering nodes, no extra text or watermark. Output a full-bleed tall portrait game screen concept.
